config.label: Hugging Bay API base URL
config.description: Hugging Bay API base URL. Defaults to https://huggingbay.xyz.

config.label: Optional bearer token for authenticated profiles
config.description: Optional bearer token for authenticated profiles. Public discovery requires no token.

config.label: npm 0
config.description: npm 0.1.13 defaults to 28 discovery tools. Core, full and verify are opt-in profiles; inspect tools/list for their schemas and counts. Hosted discovery is a separate, independently updated surface.

config.label: Set to 1 to expose the stdio-only run_local tool on tools/list
config.description: Set to 1 to expose the stdio-only run_local tool on tools/list. Defaults off. Requires local hbay 0.2.0; not available on hosted /api/mcp.
